description: Rename-aware relabel SOUNDNESS (task #64): a move that ADDS residue must NOT be laundered. The emitter's relabel REFUSED to relabel (P4 NEW occurrence-set NOT a subset of OLD — the new file grew a residue line), so the frozen merge-base face still carries the OLD path key while the candidate carries the NEW path key. The firewall (content-blind; opaque residue code by design) differences candidate (new path) vs frozen (old path): the new path is current\frozen = a NEW regression AND proposed\frozen = ratchet growth => RED on both predicates. This is the exact hole the content-subset guard closes; the relabel can never manufacture a false-GREEN. The relabel refusal itself is pinned in the emitter's relabel_red_add_residue_does_not_relabel unit test.
